name: proposal-kit
description: A tiny design system for one solar proposal summary. Three components carry every amount a homeowner signs: Money, PaymentLine and SavingsEstimate. Made-up data; unofficial sample.
rules: Build proposal views only from Money, PaymentLine, SavingsEstimate and the shadcn/ui primitives Card, Badge, Button and Separator.
Never type a currency string such as "$24,900" and never format currency yourself (no Intl.NumberFormat with style currency, no toLocaleString currency, no "$" + value). Pass whole cents to Money.
Never show a monthly payment except through PaymentLine. It requires apr and termMonths, so the APR and term always sit on the same line.
Never show savings except through SavingsEstimate. It always says Estimated and always prints its assumptions (kWh a year, rate per kWh, yearly increase, years).

Use token classes only (bg-card, text-foreground, text-muted-foreground, border, bg-primary, bg-success, bg-estimate and the others listed under tokens). No hex, rgb, px, inline style sizes or Tailwind palette classes such as bg-green-500; the palette is switched off.
Status is never shown by color alone. Use a Badge with words, and an icon if you like.
Do not mention tax credits, rebates or incentive amounts.

tokens.spacing: Tailwind spacing classes (p-4, gap-2, mt-6 ...) are multiples of --pk-space-unit (0.25rem).
tokens.contrast: Every text token pair is at least 4.5:1 in light and dark (src/styles/tokens.test.ts).

components.name: Money
components.purpose: Shows any amount of money on a proposal: prices, line items, down payment, totals. The only place that formats currency.

props.name: cents
props.description: The amount in whole cents. 2490000 is $24,900. Never pass dollars. Throws on fractions of a cent.

props.name: precision
props.description: auto hides .00 on whole-dollar amounts; cents always shows two decimals; dollars rounds to whole dollars.

do: Convert dollars to cents once, at the data layer: 24900 dollars is cents={2490000}.
Use precision="dollars" only for rounded estimates.
dont: Don't call Intl.NumberFormat or toLocaleString with style currency.

components.name: PaymentLine
components.purpose: Shows a monthly loan payment with its APR and term on the same line, so a payment is never shown without the cost of the loan.

props.name: monthlyCents
props.description: The monthly payment in whole cents. 16028 is $160.28.

props.name: apr
props.description: Annual percentage rate as a percent: 5.99 means 5.99% APR.

props.name: termMonths
props.description: Loan term in months: 300 is 25 years.

props.name: lender
props.description: Lender or program name, printed under the terms.

do: Pass the real apr and termMonths from the loan offer.
Use one PaymentLine per loan option.
dont: Don't write "$160/mo" or "per month" next to a Money.
Don't make apr or termMonths optional or pass 0 to hide them.
components.example: <PaymentLine monthlyCents={16028} apr={5.99} termMonths={300} lender="Made-up Credit Union solar loan" />

components.name: SavingsEstimate
components.purpose: Shows estimated bill savings. Computes the figure from the assumptions, always labels it Estimated and always prints the assumptions under it.

props.name: assumptions
props.type: { annualKwh: number; ratePerKwhCents: number; yearlyIncreasePct: number; years: number }
props.description: Yearly production in kWh, today's utility rate in cents per kWh (16 is $0.16), yearly rate increase as a percent (3 is 3%), and years covered.

props.name: label
props.description: Heading. If it does not start with Estimated, the component adds it.

do: Pass the same assumptions the proposal uses everywhere else.
Let the component compute the figure; do not pass a savings number.
dont: Don't show a savings figure in your own markup.
Don't hide or shorten the assumptions line.
Don't add tax credits or incentives to savings.

primitives.name: Card
primitives.import: import { Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter } from "@/components/ui/card";
primitives.purpose: Groups one topic: system, price, payment, savings.

primitives.name: Badge
primitives.purpose: Status in words. Variants: default, secondary, success, estimate, outline.

primitives.name: Button
primitives.purpose: Actions. Variants: default, outline, secondary, ghost, link, destructive.

primitives.name: Separator
primitives.purpose: A line between groups, for example above a total.

runs: vitest (component tests, axe on the reference view, token contrast, lint rule tests)

lintRules.proposal-kit/no-raw-currency: typed currency strings and hand-made currency formatting
lintRules.proposal-kit/tokens-only: hex, rgb, px, inline px styles, arbitrary values and Tailwind palette classes
lintRules.proposal-kit/no-color-only-status: a colored dot with no words
